items.title: Scaling agentic AI for governed banking operations with Apexon and AWS
items.summary: Banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) institutions need AI systems that can act autonomously at market speed, but autonomy without governance is a nonstarter in an industry defined by regulatory intensity and operational risk. In this post, Apexon and AWS present an architecture-first approach to operationalizing agentic AI on AWS, with governance built in from the start across three layers: intelligence, orchestration and execution, and governance, security, and audit. Learn how governed agentic patterns apply to core BFSI workflows like customer onboarding, credit processing, and payments exception handling, enabling autonomy at scale while keeping every action traceable and auditable.
items.creator: Hamdy Eed
